nonBlockingFindings.finding: Pre-existing equipment portrait has a small lower-edge atlas fragment. No new artwork or corrected historical crop is claimed by this delivery.
Transient success toasts overlap part of a card while consecutive purchases complete; this is not permanent clipping.

scope: Five executed public production purchase/save groups, eight real downloaded exports and nine actually opened desktop/mobile viewports. All runtime files remained the compiled build; no private harness or state/DOM/style injection was used.
limitations: Prepared native fixtures give XP directly for a bounded menu/save inspection; that XP is not claimed earned in this browser.
One Normandy soldier, one Normandy engineer and one early Eden engineer context are inspected. Complete original talent trees and physical controller/hardware performance are not certified.
All talent ranks, durations and multipliers remain ATB adaptations. Native combat effects have separate integration tests.
